provenance.notes: Read 2026-11-10: the SSD API Fair Use Policy (ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov) asks for only the requests a use needs, one API request at a time (no simultaneous requests), results stored and reused, backing off after errors, and requires automated applications to send an application-specific User-Agent with the product name, version and contact information. JPL may rate-limit, throttle or block unreasonable load; no figure is published; the APIs may not be embedded in a website (NASA CORS policy). No data licence is stated. The Horizons API (ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api) is listed among those SSD APIs; its own page states no limit (optional EMAIL_ADDR parameter, for follow-up only); the Horizons manual asks e-mail automation to space requests by 1 to 2 s (e-mail interface, not the API).
